coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 8 of 9 ground-truth variable items (89%): weight-only quantization with FP16 activations, WikiText-2 evaluation at sequence length 2048, an FP16 baseline, all three model sizes, all three weight precisions, all four quantization methods, perplexity, and Inf/NaN stability detection.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The quantization scheme is incorrect: the output specifies symmetric rather than asymmetric per-column quantization. It also introduces auxiliary grouped quantization and additional evaluations outside the target design. FP16 KV-cache precision is not explicitly confirmed, and references to BF16 make the otherwise specified FP16 baseline less consistent.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth results.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion or results were supplied, including the low-bit improvements from QuaRot-GPTQ, RTN failures, limited stabilization of RTN by QuaRot, and the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
